name: MultiThreadedCalculation
description: Returns or sets the concurrent calculation mode.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: The Enabled property allows MultiThreadedCalculation objects to be enabled or disabled at run time. Read/write.

properties.name: ThreadMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the thread mode for the specified MultiThreadedCalculation object. Read/write XlThreadMode.

properties.name: ThreadCount
properties.description: Gets the total count of the process threads that are a part of the specified MultiThreadedCalculation object.
